summary: Accept fractal member creation and inbox tag spellings while preserving legacy writers.

replay.detail: No replay or rewriting of historical data.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Readers accept fractal.client.create-* and fractal-message/to/sha256/attachment tags alongside st3 spellings. Each key selects legacy values if present, with no malformed-value fallthrough or cross-family merging. All selected-family message and attachment tags remain readable. Writers and hash/signature domains are unchanged.

manual.detail: No manual migration; legacy data remains supported.

recovery.detail: No data migration to undo; writers retain legacy spellings.
